blocks.text: Garden Village homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Garden Village, September 2026. Detached houses: 9 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11%. No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Garden Village between June and September.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 3 sold over 4 months against an average of 9.0 listed, about 12.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 1 sold.

items.t: Simon Fraser University Area real estate

faq.a: In south-west Burnaby, west of Metrotown toward Boundary Road, around Central Park and Patterson Station. Heritage Burnaby places the Garden Village subdivision inside the Central Park historic neighbourhood — a 140-acre site developed from 1953 with a plan for 500 modern homes.

faq.q: Is there SkyTrain in Garden Village?
faq.a: Patterson Station, on the Expo Line at Patterson Avenue by Central Park, serves the sub-area's north side, and Metrotown Station — the area's main bus exchange — is the next station east.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Garden Village address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. SD41 schools in or beside the sub-area include Windsor Elementary (K–7) and Moscrop Secondary (8–12), with Burnaby South Secondary (8–12), 5455 Rumble St, on the south side; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.
